+def _interval_solver(capacity, tie):
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        by_id = {j["id"]: j for j in jobs}
+        if mandatory & blocked or not mandatory.issubset(by_id) or len(mandatory) > k:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+
+        best_value = None
+        best_ids = None
+        candidates = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] not in blocked]
+        for subset in combinations(candidates, k):
+            ids = [j["id"] for j in subset]
+            if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for j in subset:
+                counts[j["group"]] = counts.get(j["group"], 0) + 1
+            if any(not lo <= counts.get(group, 0) <= hi
+                   for group, (lo, hi) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            valid = True
+            for t in {j["start"] for j in subset}:
+                if sum(j["start"] <= t < j["end"] for j in subset) > capacity:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            selected = sorted(ids)
+            value = sum(j["value"] for j in subset)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and
+                 ((tie == "smallest" and selected < best_ids) or
+                  (tie == "largest" and selected > best_ids)))):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+    return solve
+

+def _build_component_06():
+    def rounded(n, d, mode):
+        if mode == "half_up":
+            return (2 * n + d) // (2 * d)
+        return n // d
+
+    def solve(data):
+        cutoff = data.get("cutoff", 10**9)
+        winners = {}
+        for pos, event in enumerate(data["events"]):
+            seq = event.get("sequence", 0)
+            if seq > cutoff:
+                continue
+            event_id = event.get("id", "anonymous:" + str(pos))
+            key = (seq, event.get("revision", 0), pos)
+            if event_id not in winners or key > winners[event_id][0]:
+                winners[event_id] = (key, event)
+
+        balances = dict(data.get("opening", {}))
+        mode = data["rounding"]
+        for _, event in winners.values():
+            if event.get("void", False):
+                continue
+            raw = event["price"] * event.get("quantity", 1)
+            discount = min(10000, max(0, event.get("discount_bp", 0)))
+            net = rounded(raw * (10000 - discount), 10000, mode)
+            tax = rounded(net * event.get("tax_bp", 0), 10000, mode)
+            amount = net + tax
+            if event.get("kind") == "refund":
+                amount = -amount
+            key = event.get("account", "default") + "|" + event.get("currency", "USD")
+            balances[key] = balances.get(key, 0) + amount
+        return {"balances": balances}
+    return solve
+

+def _build_component_07():
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        roots = data["roots"]
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        best = None
+
+        def search(chosen, constraints, edges):
+            nonlocal best
+            # Check all already selected versions against accumulated ranges and pins.
+            for name, version in chosen.items():
+                if any(not (lo <= version <= hi) for lo, hi in constraints.get(name, [])):
+                    return
+                if name in pins and version != pins[name]:
+                    return
+
+            # Choose an unresolved constrained package in ascending name order.
+            unresolved = [n for n in names
+                          if n in constraints and n not in chosen]
+            if not unresolved:
+                # Active closure is complete; reject directed cycles.
+                state, done = set(), set()
+                def visit(n):
+                    if n in state:
+                        return False
+                    if n in done:
+                        return True
+                    state.add(n)
+                    if any(not visit(m) for m in edges.get(n, [])):
+                        return False
+                    state.remove(n)
+                    done.add(n)
+                    return True
+                if not all(visit(n) for n in edges):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(n, -1) for n in names)
+                if best is None or vector > best[0]:
+                    best = (vector, dict(chosen))
+                return
+
+            name = unresolved[0]
+            ranges = constraints[name]
+            lo = max(r[0] for r in ranges)
+            hi = min(r[1] for r in ranges)
+            forbidden = set(blocked.get(name, []))
+            rows = [r for r in packages[name]
+                    if lo <= r["version"] <= hi and r["version"] not in forbidden
+                    and (name not in pins or r["version"] == pins[name])]
+            # Maximum versions are tried first; final vector determines preference.
+            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["version"], reverse=True)
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                next_constraints = {n: list(rs) for n, rs in constraints.items()}
+                next_edges = {n: list(es) for n, es in edges.items()}
+                next_edges[name] = []
+                ok = True
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    target = dep["name"]
+                    next_constraints.setdefault(target, []).append((dep["min"], dep["max"]))
+                    next_edges[name].append(target)
+                    if target in next_chosen:
+                        v = next_chosen[target]
+                        if not dep["min"] <= v <= dep["max"]:
+                            ok = False
+                            break
+                if ok:
+                    search(next_chosen, next_constraints, next_edges)
+
+        initial = {name: [tuple(bounds)] for name, bounds in roots.items()}
+        search({}, initial, {})
+        if best is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best[1]}
+    return solve
+
